coverage.summary: Applies to landlords renting any residential dwelling unit (any primary residence) in Hoboken. Medical/long-term care and detention facilities are excluded. There is no unit-count, building-age or landlord-size threshold.
coverage.other_conditions: A residential dwelling unit is defined as any primary residence, excluding medical/long-term care or detention facilities.

evidence.quoted_span: Landlords who rent any residential dwelling unit (defined as any primary residence excluding medical/long-term care or detention facilities) in the City of Hoboken are prohibited from price fixing using algorithmic pricing.

result.notes: The coverage is confirmed against DX01 without changes. The ordinance applies to any residential dwelling unit (any primary residence) in Hoboken, with only medical/long-term care and detention facilities excluded. It sets no unit-count, construction-date, building-age, owner-occupancy or landlord-size threshold. The preemption flags stay null: the possible FAIR Act preemption in the conflict note is not addressed in the supplied documents. Section Two's repealer covers only inconsistent local ordinances and says nothing about state law.
